notes.title: 10 More Levels - Update #4
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes[/b]

-Camera Works A Little better 

-10 More Levels 

-Themed Levels 

-Animated Menus

-music Does not stop when playing and switching menus

notes.title: Patch Notes #3 - Fixes
notes.content:
-Achivements Now Are Able To Be Gained By playing the game, no need to start a level through the level selection screen anymore.
-Camera Bug where there was one "dead" pixel. The camera would not move if you were in that exact spot
-Quality of life changes

notes.title: Update Notes - Controller Suppport!
notes.content:
[b]Main Features[/b]
-The Game Finally has Controller Support! 
-Animated Menus Were added

notes.title: Update Notes October 23th
notes.content:
